chatFlows.label: Backlog burn-down
chatFlows.response:
Backlog is down because August is the first month since the outage where we resolved faster than we opened — 474 closed against 447 new, taking open incidents from the July peak of 74 to 47.

{{chart:trend}}

- **July spike:** 521 tickets opened — the Jul 28 GlobalProtect failover (1,890 users down 4h12m) plus the Win11 24H2 patch wave.
- **Surge rota:** Lena Park's team has run doubled APAC coverage since Aug 1.
- **Triage bot:** auto-routing now assigns 68% of new tickets untouched, pulling MTTR to 3.4h from 4.6h in July.

> Monday still lands ~34 tickets before 10:00 — heaviest block of the week.

Recommend holding the surge rota through Aug 15, then stepping back to normal rotation once the backlog sits under 40.

actions.label: Extend surge rota to Aug 15
actions.toast: Rota updated in ServiceNow — Lena Park's team confirmed through Aug 15

chatFlows.label: Outage RCA brief

toolCalls.result: v7 · 2 open comments from Ingrid Larsson

chatFlows.response:
## GlobalProtect outage — RCA in one screen

**Root cause:** an expired intermediate certificate on the Singapore gateway pair, compounded by a failover config that pointed both gateways at the same certificate store — so the backup died with the primary.

|Item|Detail|
|---|---|
|Impact|1,890 APAC users · 4h12m on Jul 28|
|Uptime hit|July fell to 99.71% vs 99.9% SLA|
|Detection|11 min — the Datadog cert alert was muted|
|Corrective actions|5 total — 3 closed, 2 open|

Open items: automated cert-expiry scanning and the failover runbook (ITOPS-2841, in review), plus a quarterly failover drill starting September.

> Priya Raghavan expects the final RCA Monday — the Confluence draft is at v7 with 2 unresolved comments from Ingrid Larsson.

Recommend resolving both comments at the 10:30 PIR today and sending Priya the summary this afternoon so Monday is a formality.

actions.label: Send RCA summary to Priya
actions.toast: Summary drafted in Outlook to Priya Raghavan — ready for review

chatFlows.label: Access call
chatFlows.response:
**Approve, with guardrails.** Elena Petrova's request (RITM-8841) is low-risk and properly sponsored.

- **Scope:** read-only on the Aurora prod replica — no write path, no PII tables.
- **Sponsor:** James Whitfield; Workday confirms Elena is active DevOps in London, 2+ years tenure.
- **Precedent:** 3 similar grants in Q2, zero security incidents.

Conditions to attach: 90-day expiry, session audit logging, replica endpoint only.

{{chart:donut}}

Bigger picture — access & identity is now 31% of ticket volume, our largest category. ITOPS-2812 (auto-provisioned access packs, in progress) should cut this class of request roughly in half.

> The request breaches its 24h SLA at 15:00 today.

Recommend approving with the 90-day expiry now and adding Elena to the Q4 access recertification list.
